NexusAI is an independent chat assistant designed by Ankit Chand. It uses Python, asyncio, Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o), Pydantic, FastAPI, Server-Sent Events, Streamlit, SQLite, httpx, pytest, Kotlin / Jetpack Compose (Android client). The code is not public, but Ankit can provide a walkthrough on request. The key features include answers that combine several specialists in one turn, offline fallbacks for network tools, and PII redaction. The system has 8 specialist agents, 31 tools in 9 modules, and 214 offline tests passing. Automated tests pass fully offline, and a fake LLM client lets the whole suite run without spending tokens. All network calls go through one seam, so a single fixture can cut the network and exercise every tool's fallback path.
